svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.9.8.6 Mezzanine Means of Egress
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.9.8.6 Mezzanine Means of Egress
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.9 MEANS OF EGRESS
Mezzanine Means of Egress

g.text: Means of egress to exits accessible at the
mezzanine level, as for floor areas
Exception: occupant load 60 max., area and
the egress door or an egress stairway
One means of egress may lead through the
room below, if all others lead to exits

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
The space above a mezzanine is served by means of egress
leading to exits accessible at the mezzanine level, on the
same basis as floor areas
Except as permitted by Sentences (2) and (3).
The means of egress from a mezzanine need not conform to
Sentence (1), provided
(a) it is not required to terminate at a vertical fire
separation (Sentence 9.10.12.1.(2)), (b) its occupant load is
not more than 60, (c) its area does not exceed Table 9.9.7.4.,
and (d) the distance limits of Table 9.9.7.4., measured along
the path of travel, are not exceeded from any point on it to (i)
the egress door of the space it overlooks, if that space has a
single egress door, or (ii) an egress stairway leading to an
access to exit below, if that space requires 2 or more egress
doorways by Sentence 9.9.7.4.(1).
One means of egress from a mezzanine not required to
terminate at a fire separation, and exceeding the limits of
Sentence (2), may lead through the room it is located in
Provided all other means of egress from that mezzanine lead to
exits accessible at the mezzanine level.
The maximum travel distance from any point on a mezzanine to
the nearest exit is not more than
(a) 40 m (131′-2¾″) in a business and personal services
occupancy, (b) 45 m (147′-7⅝″) in a floor area sprinklered
throughout, without a high-hazard industrial occupancy, or (c)
30 m (98′-5⅛″) in any other floor area. Except as provided in
Sentence (2).
Drawn: a room with a mezzanine (gold), front walls cut low. Green dashed: a means of egress through the room below.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.9.8.6. (page 9-53)
